summary: 6rd gives IPv6 access across an IPv4 access network using 6-in-4 tunnels from customer equipment. This informational RFC proposes Gateway-initiated 6rd, where the tunnels start at an operator-owned gateway instead, so customer equipment needs no changes and no IPv4 address for it.

eli5.summary: Instead of every home building its own bridge to the new road, the town builds one big bridge, so homes do not have to do anything.
